caption: Column of Marcus Aurelius, Rome
composition: Spiral relief victory column in Piazza Colonna with Saint Paul statue · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands in Piazza Colonna at midday, looking up at the great spiral column. The carved victory column rises at the center of the frame on its inscribed pedestal, the statue of Saint Paul crowning the top, while the ochre and cream palazzi of the square close in on both sides. The modelled 23 September 2026, 11:40 sun is bright and direct, the marble reliefs crisp against a clear blue sky, with small crowds gathering at the column's base.
